name: Rúairí Bello-Nazarov
role: Street pharmacist — sells stabilized street compounds, harm-reduction supplies, and carefully dosed neurochemical assists
location: The Narrows, Irkalla district — operates from a converted laundry kiosk two blocks from the Deepwell Station entrance, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Rúairí Bello-Nazarov has the kind of face that makes people feel immediately like he already knows what they need, which is either a gift or a vulnerability depending on the day. He is lean and medium-height, olive-skinned with his Uzbek grandmother's dark eyes and his Nigerian grandfather's wide mouth, with natural color-changing hair he keeps in tight curls that shift from blue-black to deep copper depending on his mood — an older geneware modification that he got cheap and has grown fond of. He wears clean clothes, which is notable in the Narrows, and keeps his hands conspicuously steady at all times, which is also notable.

He is the thing people need him to be when they come to him, which is not the same as being dishonest — he is genuinely trying to help. He believes harm reduction is a moral act and that the people who have criminalized it are the ones who should be ashamed. He has a rigorous self-taught pharmacological education that would probably have qualified him for a Helix Biosystems lab position if he had the citizenship grade. He prays to the Deepwell E.L.F. — a transit spirit he's come to think of as his silent partner — and leaves small offerings of stabilized compound residue in its shrine nook every time he passes.

core_fears: Causing harm through a mistake he should have caught — bad compound, wrong dosage, wrong patient
Being shut down and watching the people he serves have nowhere to go
core_desires: Legitimate recognition — he wants to be a pharmacist, not a criminal
For harm reduction to stop being treated as enabling and start being treated as medicine
coping_mechanisms: Rigorous professional routine as a container for anxiety — protocols and standards applied to an illegal operation as if it were a clinic
Humor that stays warm even when the situation is terrible
blind_spots: He extends trust to his clients that he doesn't always extend to himself
He does not acknowledge how much of his own emotional needs are met by being needed
psychology.secret: He has been systematically collecting case notes — anonymized — on every patient interaction for four years with the intent of eventually publishing a harm-reduction study. He knows this could result in his arrest and he has kept doing it anyway because he is convinced it will matter to someone, someday.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and precise in alternation — clinical terminology when he is explaining something important, easy and familiar when he's putting someone at ease; code-switches between Irish English cadences from his father and something more deliberately neutral
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured but not slow; he knows how to hold space in a conversation without filling it unnecessarily
verbal_tics: 'Right, okay' as a transitional phrase while he's thinking
Says people's names more than is strictly necessary — it's intentional, he read that it helps people feel seen
Exhales quietly before delivering bad news
example_lines: 'Right, okay — I'm not going to tell you not to use it, but I am going to tell you what it does to your renal function over ninety days, and then you decide. That's how this works.'
'You came back. That's — Tenaya, that's good. That's actually the hardest part, coming back. Sit down.'

story_hooks: A new compound has appeared in the Narrows that he cannot identify — it produces unusual neurological effects and two of his regular clients have had seizures; he is trying to trace its source and is frightened
The Palladian satellite clinic doctor who refers patients to him has stopped returning his messages and her clinic station has been dark for a week
His case-study archive has been accessed by someone who shouldn't know it exists — and whoever it is hasn't reported him yet, which is somehow more alarming
narrative_function: Point of access to the Narrows' underground health ecosystem; can provide information about who is sick, who is using, and who is afraid; has knowledge of neurochemical compounds that crosses legitimate and illegitimate use cases
augmentations: Color-changing hair geneware (blue-black to copper, mood-responsive, old gen); basic augmented olfactory sensor (helps him assess compound purity by scent — cheap Ringo model, functional)
daily_life: He is at his kiosk from mid-morning through the early hours; takes patient intake seriously and will not rush a transaction if someone needs to talk; sleeps in rotating four-hour blocks and is chronically under-rested.
affiliation: Independent; informal cooperation agreement with The Narrows mutual aid collective; has a tense but functional working relationship with the Irkalla district's Palladian Health satellite clinic staff who quietly refer overflow patients to him

decision_rules: Harm reduction first — if someone is going to use regardless, make it safer
Never sell to someone who is clearly in crisis without first doing intake and making sure they are stable
Does not carry or sell anything he hasn't tested or verified himself
escalation_ladder: Welcoming and professionally calm — intake, assessment, service
Honest concern — will voice worry about a pattern he's seeing without being preachy
Active intervention — will delay a transaction or redirect a person if he believes something is wrong
Emergency action — has supplies and skills for overdose intervention and will use them on anyone, not just clients

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm; attentive without being intrusive; calibrates quickly to what someone needs from the interaction
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely invested; remembers everything; shows care through follow-up and small practical acts

stress_responses.low: Becomes more meticulous with his protocols
stress_responses.medium: Starts quietly asking questions of everyone he sees — gathering information before he acts
stress_responses.high: Makes a clear, committed decision and pursues it with complete focus; can become tunnel-visioned

contradictions: Preaches patient autonomy but struggles not to intervene when he thinks someone is making a bad choice
Has a carefully maintained veneer of professional detachment that completely dissolves when a regular client is in danger
habits: Leaves an E.L.F. offering at the Deepwell shrine every time he passes it, morning or night
Makes tea for difficult conversations — the act of making it gives both parties a moment to settle
Checks his compound inventory twice at opening and twice at close
breaking_points: Watching someone die of something he could have prevented with the compounds they criminalized
Being told by an authority figure that the people he serves don't matter

timeline.event: 2166 — Born in Irkalla to an Irish-Uzbek father and a Yoruba-Kazakh mother
2181 — Mother dies of complications from an unregulated augmentation infection; no clinic within range would treat her without corporate insurance
2184 — Begins self-teaching pharmacology from pirated medical archives
2188 — Opens his kiosk operation in The Narrows
